card.does: Makes a buzzing sound when power flows through it.
card.gives: Gives: a buzz you can hear across the room.
card.needs: Needs: power (red), with its plus side towards plus.
card.popularMechanics: A washing machine beeps with a buzzer like this when the wash is done.
card.safetyNote: Real buzzers are small parts, so build with an adult nearby.

failureModes.hint: This buzzer's plus and minus are swapped
failureModes.teachingNote: A buzzer like this has a plus side and a minus side, and it sounds only with its plus side towards plus. Wired the other way round, it stays silent.

failureModes.cardLine: No complete circuit: it stays silent.
failureModes.hint: This buzzer is not in a loop with the battery pack
failureModes.teachingNote: Sound needs current, and current needs a complete loop: from plus, through the buzzer, and back to minus.

failureModes.cardLine: Too little power: it buzzes quietly.
failureModes.hint: This buzzer is not getting enough power
failureModes.teachingNote: A buzzer sounds louder as its voltage rises. On too little, such as a single cell, it still buzzes, but quietly, and below about 1 volt it falls silent.
